aiDataFlow: At the pinned CLI revision, the AI path sends one prompt per successfully loaded changed file to OpenAI's `gpt-4o` through the OpenAI Agents SDK. Modified files contribute `git diff` output; untracked files contribute their full content. The SDK reads `OPENAI_API_KEY`; `--api-key` is only stored and validated at this revision and does not configure the SDK request. The report is written locally to `diffgraph.html` by default or to the `--output` path. WildestAI has not independently verified OpenAI retention, training-use, account-control, or charge terms; consult the terms for the user's OpenAI API account.
